title: release-engineering-meeting-notes-2026-07-07
body:
Attendees: Maya Patel (owner), Ethan Kim, Priya Singh, Liam O'Connor, Zoe Martinez, QA: Aaron Blake (joined for hotfix discussion)

Agenda:
- Current release train status (v2026.07)
- Hotfix rollout for embedding service (JIRA-RE-421)
- Change log review for last two weeks
- Canary metrics and rollback criteria
- Upcoming dependencies & infra maintenance windows
- Action items and owners

1) Release train status
- Cut for v2026.07 branch happened 2026-07-05 as planned. Build artifacts published to internal registry and annotated in the release board.
- Release components: serving-runtime (quantized kernels), api-gateway changes (rate-limiter tweak), embeddings-service patch.
- Current blocker: integration test flakiness on long-context regression tests (flaky_seq_test). Root cause suspected in recent KV-cache change (PR 1287).
- ETA to unblock: Priya to triage test flakes today; expected mitigation by EOD 2026-07-07. If not resolved, we will hold rollout for serving-runtime and proceed with API-only components.

2) Hotfix: embeddings-service (JIRA-RE-421)
- Issue: intermittent 500s from embeddings-service under burst traffic observed 2026-07-06 22:00 UTC. Failure mode: memory spike due to cache eviction race.
- Hotfix PR opened (github.com/redwood-inference/embeddings/pull/342) — includes locking around the LRU cache and a metrics increment for eviction spikes.
- QA run: Aaron validated on staging with synthetic burst (1k reqs/s) and no 500s over 30m window.
- Rollout plan: staged rollout to production (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%) with 15-minute observation windows. Canary start scheduled 2026-07-07 18:30 UTC.
- Rollback plan: revert-by-traffic-split in traffic router; if error rate > 0.5% or latency P95 increases > 30% for two consecutive windows, roll back to previous revision.

3) Change log review (last two weeks)
- Highlights to include in public change log (internal release notes draft):
  * Improved KV cache eviction stability for embeddings-service (hotfix)
  * API rate limiter tuned to reduce tail latency on small requests
  * Performance improvements in quantized attention kernels (serving-runtime) — internal benchmarks show ~12% throughput gain for medium sequence loads
  * Bugfix: long-context seq regression tests flakiness (investigation ongoing)
- Owners: Maya to draft public-facing bullet points; Priya to add internal technical notes for partner teams.

4) Canary metrics and SLOs
- Canary dashboards: latency (P50/P95), error rate, token throughput, CPU/GPU utilization, memory consumption, eviction metrics for caches.
- Canary thresholds for this cycle:
  * Error rate threshold: 0.5%
  * P95 latency increase threshold: +30% over baseline
  * GPU utilization change: > +20% sustained for 10m flags for investigation (not immediate rollback)
- Monitoring: Alerting configured in PagerDuty for on-call (rotation: Ethan on-call for infra, Priya for runtime). Slack hook will post canary progression in #release-engineering.

5) Infra maintenance & dependencies
- Network team plans maintenance on 2026-07-10 01:00-03:00 UTC affecting eu-west-1 peering. Release team to avoid critical rollouts during that window.
- Dependency: new container runtime (cri v5) will be enabled in staging next week; Liam to run soak tests against v2026.07 images. If regressions found, hold enabling in prod.

6) Risk register & mitigations
- Flaky integration tests: high risk for release blocking. Mitigation: quarantine flaky tests, create focused short-run regression suite for release gates. Priya to provide list by 2026-07-08.
- Hotfix regressions: medium risk. Mitigation: strict canary ramp and automatic rollback policy. Aaron to validate smoke checklist for each rollout.
- Capacity constraint for embedding-heavy customers: monitor token throughput; set temporary rate-limiter per-tenant if tail latency worsens.

7) Action items
- Priya Singh: triage flaky_seq_test failure logs, provide mitigation plan and list of tests to quarantine (due 2026-07-07 EOD).
- Ethan Kim: prepare canary dashboards and verify PagerDuty routing for tonight's embeddings hotfix rollout (due 2026-07-07 17:30 UTC).
- Aaron Blake: finalize smoke test checklist and run final staging validation for embeddings hotfix (due 2026-07-07 18:00 UTC).
- Liam O'Connor: start soak tests in staging against cri v5 with v2026.07 images (start 2026-07-08). Report any regressions by 2026-07-09.
- Maya Patel: draft public change log and internal technical notes; circulate to product and support for sign-off (draft due 2026-07-08).

Decisions made
- Proceed with embeddings-service hotfix rollout tonight with staged canary and rollback criteria as outlined.
- Hold serving-runtime rollout pending flaky test root cause or explicit triage sign-off.

Notes / Misc
- Reminder: coordinate with Customer Success on any tenant-specific rate-limiting changes before enforcement.
- QA will maintain a runbook entry for the embeddings hotfix procedure (Aaron).

Next meeting: Weekly sync scheduled 2026-07-14 09:30 PT. Short ad-hoc check-in planned 2026-07-07 19:00 UTC to confirm canary outcome.
